name: Beast Tamer's Menagerie
description: You were traveling with a small group of trained creatures when the Cataclysm struck.  Your show animals scattered, but a loyal dog and cat stayed by your side.  At least you won't face the apocalypse alone.

name: Insect Handler's Nest
description: Your field research on giant insects was interrupted by the end of the world.  Luckily, a few of the smaller specimens you'd been studying seem to have imprinted on you; they cluster around your feet and refuse to leave.

name: Dinosaur Wrangler's Camp
description: You'd been tracking the recently appeared dinosaurs for weeks when everything fell apart.  A young raptor you'd been hand-feeding stuck around; it seems to regard you as some kind of parent.  That's either endearing or terrifying.

name: Demonologist's Sanctum
description: Your occult studies attracted more attention than you bargained for.  When the barriers between dimensions crumbled, a small nether creature slipped through and latched onto you.  It follows you everywhere now; whether out of loyalty or hunger, you can't quite tell.

name: Machine Whisperer's Workshop
description: You were tinkering in your garage when the world ended.  A small hack-bot you'd been reprogramming whirrs to life and beeps at you; it seems to recognize you as friendly.  Having a flying drone at your side might just keep you alive.

name: Mycologist's Grove
description: Your fungal research garden survived the Cataclysm better than most things.  A young fungaloid has attached itself to you; it sways gently when you approach and shrinks away from strangers.  You're pretty sure it considers you part of its colony.

name: Zombie Whisperer's Refuge
description: Your research into the walking dead paid off in the worst possible way.  You know how to redirect their aggression, and a shambling zombie seems to have fixated on you as a source of treats rather than a meal.  It's as close to a pet zombie as anyone's likely to get.
